deleteFromPod.what: Remove a file from your pod; it stays on this device.

deleteLocally.what: Remove a file from this device; it stays on your pod.

forceRepush.what: Put all your files on your pod again; what is there is overwritten.

syncOnce.what: Bring your folder and your pod in line once, now.

watchStart.what: Watch your folder and put every change on your pod.

verifyPodState.what: Check whether a file is the same here and on your pod.

readNote.what: Read a note from your folder.

shareFolder.what: Share a folder with a contact.

getFileSnapshot.what: Show a file as it is now.

downloadFile.what: Fetch a shared file from the sender's pod.

saveToMyPod.what: Keep a shared file on your own pod.

folioStatus.what: Show how far your folder and your pod are in line.

listFiles.what: Show the files in your folder.

searchNotes.what: Search your notes, by meaning too.
